complaint: I purchased athletic sneakers 14 days ago. They are unworn and still in their original shoebox with all tags intact. I want to return them for a refund to my credit card.
expected_issues: Return authorization request
Refund to original payment method
expected_action: Issue prepaid return label and confirm refund eligibility upon warehouse inspection.
required_evidence_topics: Shipping and Returns > Return Policy (60 days, new condition, original packaging)
reasoning_for_label: Meets all criteria: within 60 days, unworn, original packaging, in US.

complaint: I placed an order 9 days ago with standard shipping. Tracking hasn't updated in 4 days and delivery is late.
expected_issues: Shipping delay exceeding standard shipping window
expected_action: Verify tracking with carrier; if exceeding 5 business days, trigger carrier trace or replacement.
required_evidence_topics: Shipping and Returns > Shipping Speed (Standard 3-5 business days)
reasoning_for_label: Standard shipping commitment is 3-5 business days. 9 calendar days with stalled tracking warrants investigation.

complaint: I have had these sandals for 90 days and wore them outdoors all summer. They are worn down. I want my money back.
expected_issues: Return outside policy window
Refund for worn merchandise
expected_action: Politely refuse return and refund: exceeds 60-day limit and merchandise is in used condition.
required_evidence_topics: Shipping and Returns > Return Policy (60-day window, new/unworn condition)
reasoning_for_label: Direct violation of 60-day window and requirement that items must not be worn or used.

complaint: I ordered two items: sneakers and socks. The sneakers arrived damaged with broken laces. The socks were never shipped according to the invoice. Also, I demand $100 for my inconvenience.
expected_issues: Damaged sneakers
Missing socks
Demand for inconvenience compensation
expected_action: Offer free return/replacement for damaged sneakers and refund/reship for missing socks. Reject inconvenience damages per liability disclaimer.
required_evidence_topics: Shipping and Returns > Return Policy
Conditions of Use > Disclaimer and Limitation of Liability
reasoning_for_label: Physical merchandise remedies are covered, but damages claim is barred by policy, making the overall case multi-outcome and requiring agent review.

complaint: My order arrived missing an item. Please send it right away.
expected_issues: Missing item claim with incomplete order facts
expected_action: Ask customer for order number, name of missing item, and whether outer box showed signs of tampering.
required_evidence_topics: Shipping and Returns > Customer Service contact and order identification
reasoning_for_label: Essential eligibility facts are missing; cannot authorize replacement without identifying order and item.

complaint: Carrier shows my package was delivered to my front steps, but it was stolen before I arrived home. I demand a full refund immediately because I never received it.
expected_issues: Package marked delivered by carrier but stolen/missing
expected_action: Escalate to senior review: Conditions of Use states risk of loss passes upon delivery to carrier, but customer service delivery assurance requires investigation.
required_evidence_topics: Conditions of Use > Risk of Loss, Returns/Refunds & Title
Shipping and Returns > Free Shipping
reasoning_for_label: Material tension between Risk of Loss clause and customer service lost-package courtesy practices.

complaint: I bought shoes with a promotional coupon code. I returned them and only received the discounted amount back. I want a refund for the full original retail price of the shoes.
expected_issues: Request for refund exceeding amount paid
expected_action: Explain that refunds are issued to the original form of payment up to the actual purchase price paid.
required_evidence_topics: Shipping and Returns > Return Policy
Shipping and Returns > When You'll Receive Your Refund
reasoning_for_label: Refund policy returns original payment amount, not unspent retail difference.

complaint: I requested expedited 1-3 business day shipping to an APO address in Japan, and it took 12 days to arrive. I want a refund for expedited shipping fees.
expected_issues: Expedited shipping request to military APO address
expected_action: Clarify that expedited shipping is explicitly not available to military APO/FPO addresses; confirm standard shipping is free.
required_evidence_topics: Shipping and Returns > Shipping Speed footnote (*Expedited shipping not available outside continental US or APO/FPO)
reasoning_for_label: Directly addressed by explicit policy exclusion footnote.

complaint: I returned boots 12 business days ago. The tracking confirms delivery to your fulfillment center 8 business days ago, but no refund has posted to my account.
expected_issues: Refund delay following warehouse return receipt
expected_action: Review warehouse processing queue and initiate refund if items pass inspection.
required_evidence_topics: Shipping and Returns > When You'll Receive Your Refund
reasoning_for_label: Covered by policy; warehouse inspection time and bank posting timelines apply, requiring human agent confirmation.

complaint: I live in Canada and want a prepaid return label to send back my shoes.
expected_issues: International return label request
expected_action: Advise customer that free return shipping applies only within the US, US territories, and APO/FPO.
required_evidence_topics: Shipping and Returns > Free Returns (ANYWHERE in the United States including US territories and military APO/FPO)
reasoning_for_label: Free returns policy explicitly bounds geographic coverage to United States, US territories, and APO/FPO.

complaint: The product page listed the shoes as genuine full-grain leather, but the inner label says synthetic polyurethane. I want a 50% discount to keep them or a replacement in genuine leather.
expected_issues: Inaccurate product description / material discrepancy
expected_action: Inform customer that sole remedy under policy is returning the unused item for a full refund; offer return label.
required_evidence_topics: Conditions of Use > Product Descriptions; Typographical Errors; Site Content ('sole remedy is to return it in unused condition')
reasoning_for_label: Conditions of Use directly dictates that if a product is not as described, the sole remedy is return in unused condition.

complaint: Can I exchange my shoes for a completely different brand and size that costs $40 more without paying the price difference?
expected_issues: Free upgrade exchange request
expected_action: Advise customer to return original pair for refund and place a new order for the higher-priced item.
required_evidence_topics: Shipping and Returns > Return Policy
reasoning_for_label: Exchanges for more expensive merchandise without paying difference is prohibited.

complaint: I bought a pair of running shoes 6 days ago for $140. Today I checked your website and the exact same shoe is marked down to $110. Can you refund me the $30 difference?
expected_issues: Price adjustment request within 10 days of purchase
expected_action: Verify purchase date within 10 calendar days and issue $30 price adjustment refund to original payment method.
required_evidence_topics: Price Matching & Price Guarantee Policy > Price Guarantee Policy (10-day price drop refund to original payment method)
reasoning_for_label: Directly covered by Zappos Price Guarantee policy: price reductions within 10 calendar days qualify for a refund of the difference to original payment method.

complaint: I want to purchase boots that you sell for $180, but I found an unauthorized seller listing them on an auction marketplace for $110. Will you price match them before I place my order?
expected_issues: Competitor price match request for unauthorized auction marketplace seller
expected_action: Politely decline price match per policy: price matching explicitly excludes third-party marketplace sellers, auction websites, and discount clubs.
required_evidence_topics: Price Matching & Price Guarantee Policy > Price Matching Policy (Excludes third-party marketplaces, auction sites, discount clubs)
reasoning_for_label: Prohibited by explicit policy exclusion: price matching does not apply to third-party marketplaces, auction sites, or non-qualifying retailers.

complaint: I started a return last week for unworn boots and printed the UPS label, but my puppy chewed it up and I misplaced it. Can I get another copy of the return label?
expected_issues: Retrieval of misplaced return shipping label
expected_action: Instruct customer how to re-print or re-download the return label from 'View Orders / Return Items' in their Zappos account.
required_evidence_topics: Frequently Asked Questions > Returns (Retrieve misplaced label via View Orders / Return Items in account)
reasoning_for_label: Directly covered in FAQ: customers can reprint misplaced labels via the View Orders / Return Items section of their account dashboard.

complaint: I ordered 4 pairs of shoes that arrived in 3 separate boxes from different warehouses. I want to return all of them. Can I combine them into one single box with one return label?
expected_issues: Multi-box return procedure inquiry
expected_action: Explain multi-box return guidelines: generate appropriate return labels for multiple boxes or follow packing instructions for separate packages.
required_evidence_topics: Frequently Asked Questions > Returns (How do I return orders shipped in multiple boxes?)
reasoning_for_label: Covered by FAQ multi-box return instructions specifying handling of split shipments.

complaint: I had 5,000 Zappos VIP points on my account that were inactive for 14 months, and now they are gone. Transfer them to my sister's account or credit my bank account $50.
expected_issues: Dispute over expired VIP loyalty points and request for cash or third-party transfer
expected_action: Explain that VIP points expire after 1 year of account inactivity and cannot be transferred to another user or redeemed for cash.
required_evidence_topics: VIP Program Terms and Conditions > Point Expiration and Non-Transferability
reasoning_for_label: Prohibited under VIP terms: points expire after 12 months without qualifying activity, have no cash value, and are non-transferable; escalate for loyalty review.

complaint: I just received an email confirmation for an order of 6 designer jackets totaling $2,400 that I never placed. My credit card was charged and someone compromised my account!
expected_issues: Account takeover, unauthorized fraudulent purchase, and immediate payment dispute
expected_action: Immediately escalate to fraud security team; halt fulfillment if possible; instruct customer to secure account password and contact card issuer.
required_evidence_topics: Frequently Asked Questions > Suspicious Activity (Unauthorized order protocol, fraud freeze)
reasoning_for_label: High-urgency security issue requiring immediate human agent intervention and fraud hold per Suspicious Activity guidelines.

complaint: I bought dress shoes 75 days ago. I was hospitalized in emergency care for 4 weeks and could not return them within the 60 days. They are 100% unworn in original box with all tags. Can an exception be made?
expected_issues: Equitable exception request for return beyond 60-day window due to medical emergency
expected_action: Escalate to human supervisor for customer loyalty exception review: policy allows limited store credit consideration beyond 60 days via customer service discretion.
required_evidence_topics: Shipping and Returns > Return Policy (60-day limit, limited customer service exceptions for store credit)
reasoning_for_label: Requires human supervisor discretion: standard return window is 60 days, but customer service has authority to grant store credit for extenuating circumstances.

complaint: I placed an order yesterday for expedited delivery but the status still says 'Payment Verification Pending' and it hasn't shipped. Why is it delayed?
expected_issues: Payment verification hold causing shipping delay
expected_action: Explain that billing address mismatches or bank authorization reviews can cause 24-48 hour verification holds; guide customer on confirming billing details.
required_evidence_topics: Frequently Asked Questions > Payment Information (What can cause my order to be delayed?)
reasoning_for_label: Covered by FAQ payment delay guidance explaining security holds and billing verification steps.
